name: Alcalá de Guadaíra (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and light blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alcalá de Guadaíra (a castle and keys on white above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Alcalá de Guadaíra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alcalá de Guadaíra arms — castle and keys on white above waves
keys and crown of the arms
